1000:0302.name: rtl_lxmul
1000:0302.note: Borland RTL 32-bit multiply: DX:AX * CX:BX -> DX:AX (low 32 bits)

1000:033a.name: rtl_scopy
1000:033a.note: Borland RTL far struct copy: CX bytes from far [BP+6] to far [BP+0xa], callee pops 8

1000:0488.name: rtl_lxlsh
1000:0488.note: Borland RTL 32-bit shift left of DX:AX by CL

1000:04a9.name: rtl_lxrsh
1000:04a9.note: Borland RTL 32-bit arithmetic shift right of DX:AX by CL

1000:04c9.name: rtl_lxursh
1000:04c9.note: Borland RTL 32-bit logical shift right of DX:AX by CL

1000:06fc.name: rtl_setbuf
1000:06fc.note: setbuf: full buffering of 512 bytes with the given buffer, unbuffered when it is null

1000:0a3e.name: rtl_fclose
1000:0a3e.note: fclose: flushes, closes the DOS handle, resets the FILE; -1 for an unused FILE

1000:0cff.name: rtl_fopen
1000:0cff.note: fopen(name, mode): takes a free FILE and opens it; returns the FILE pointer or 0

1000:0df7.name: rtl_fread
1000:0df7.note: fread(buf, size, count, file): returns whole items read

1000:0ea1.name: rtl_fseek
1000:0ea1.note: fseek(file, offsetLo, offsetHi, whence): drops buffered data, returns 0 or -1

1000:0f0b.name: rtl_ftell
1000:0f0b.note: ftell(file): DOS position corrected by buffered bytes, in DX:AX

1000:0f5a.name: rtl_fwrite
1000:0f5a.note: fwrite(buf, size, count, file): returns whole items written

1000:1041.name: rtl_fgetc
1000:1041.note: fgetc(file): next byte, or 0xFFFF at end or on error

1000:144d.name: rtl_fputc
1000:144d.note: fputc(byte, file): returns the byte, or 0xFFFF on error

1000:197e.name: rtl_stricmp
1000:197e.note: stricmp(a, b): string compare that folds a..z to upper case

1000:19dc.name: rtl_strncpy
1000:19dc.note: strncpy(dst, src, n): copies up to n bytes and pads the rest with zeros

1008:0000.name: platform_winMain
1008:0000.note: WinMain: /c opens the config dialog, /s runs the saver, any other arg shows dialog 0x6d and then runs; registers the window class, creates a full-screen window, posts WM_USER, runs the message loop

1008:0221.name: platform_defScreenSaverProc
1008:0221.note: Default message handling: mouse move over 3 px, clicks, key down, or deactivation request exit; WM_DESTROY posts quit; then DefWindowProc

1008:0c5c.name: platform_loadSettings
1008:0c5c.note: Reads all SCRANTIC.INI keys (Background, Clouds, Waves, Sounds, NumDays, CurrentYear, StartTime, ...) into globals

1008:0dc8.name: platform_saveSettings
1008:0dc8.note: Writes the same SCRANTIC.INI keys back with WritePrivateProfileString

1008:0fcd.name: platform_screenSaverProc
1008:0fcd.note: Exported window procedure: create loads settings and starts a 50 ms timer, destroy saves settings, paint blits the offscreen image, timer runs timer callbacks and the idle callback, WM_USER checks free memory then runs init

1008:12eb.name: platform_setDialogStartTime
1008:12eb.note: Normalizes an HHMM start time (wraps at 24:00 with a beep, snaps to :00 or :30), stores it, and shows it in dialog item 0x6e

1008:13cd.name: platform_pumpInputMessage
1008:13cd.note: Peeks one pending keyboard or mouse message and dispatches it, with a busy flag set meanwhile

1008:143c.name: platform_initSaver
1008:143c.note: Startup: reads RESOURCE.MAP, sets 640x480, loads JOHNCAST.PAL, shows INTRO.SCR, registers a timer callback, draws the island, loads JOHNWALK, sets the cleanup and idle callbacks

1008:15c8.name: story_idleTick
1008:15c8.note: Idle callback: runs one scene step, then updates elapsed-time counters from GetCurrentTime

1010:0136.name: story_drawIsland
1010:0136.note: First call loads HOLIDAY.BMP, BACKGRND.BMP, MRAFT.BMP; later calls draw the background (NIGHT.SCR, a random OCEAN0x.SCR from table 1068:0262, or a fill), place the island, and set up clouds and waves

1018:0000.name: walk_loadJohnWalkBmp
1018:0000.note: Loads JOHNWALK.BMP once and resets three walk-state globals

1018:06bf.name: story_stepScene
1018:06bf.note: One scene step: when the scene queue is empty builds a new one and logs New Scene; otherwise loads the entry's ADS by id and runs its tag

1018:0c62.name: ads_loadAdsById
1018:0c62.note: Looks up an ADS id in the table at 1068:166e, unloads the previous ADS when the id changes, loads and caches the file; id -2 loads from a buffer at 1068:361c

1018:1008.name: resources_diskRetryHook
1018:1008.note: Returns its argument; called by the open retry loops, does nothing

1018:1019.name: resources_openFile
1018:1019.note: Opens a resource: loose file first, else by name hash in the archive, then checks the stored name case-insensitively; returns a file slot

1018:1204.name: resources_closeFile
1018:1204.note: Closes a resource handle: frees the file slot (closing a loose file) or fcloses a plain FILE

1018:1287.name: resources_readFile
1018:1287.note: fread-like read from an open resource file: buffer, item size, count, handle; returns items read

1018:1398.name: resources_seekFile
1018:1398.note: fseek-like seek on an open resource file: handle, 32-bit offset, whence

1018:1475.name: resources_tellFile
1018:1475.note: ftell-like position of an open resource file, returned in DX:AX

1018:14cc.name: resources_rewindFile
1018:14cc.note: Seeks a resource handle to position 0

1018:14e9.name: resources_getFileByte
1018:14e9.note: getc-like read of one byte from an open resource file, 0xFFFF at end

1018:15d2.name: resources_eofFile
1018:15d2.note: feof-like: archived resource at or past its size, or the runtime end-of-file flag

1018:1637.name: resources_writeFile
1018:1637.note: fwrite-like: archived resources write nothing and return 0; loose files go to fwrite

1018:16b7.name: resources_putFileByte
1018:16b7.note: fputc-like: archived resources return -1; loose files go to fputc

1018:1720.name: resources_setFileBuffer
1018:1720.note: setbuf-like: no-op for archived resources; loose files go to setbuf

1018:1771.name: resources_readResourceMap
1018:1771.note: Reads RESOURCE.MAP once: header, then per archive a 13-byte name and a list of 8-byte entries into a table at 1068:3365

1018:18d2.name: resources_freeResourceMap
1018:18d2.note: Frees every archive entry table and marks the map as not loaded

1018:1947.name: resources_forceArchiveReopen
1018:1947.note: Sets the flag that makes the next open reopen the archive file

1018:195a.name: resources_hashName
1018:195a.note: Uppercases a name in place, drops any path, and hashes 4 bytes at the map positions plus sum*xor into globals

1018:1a42.name: resources_findMapEntry
1018:1a42.note: Finds a map entry by the current name hash, current archive first, and fills a file slot with archive and offset

1018:1bc3.name: resources_selectArchive
1018:1bc3.note: Makes an archive current, closing the old archive file and opening the new one in a retry loop

1018:1caf.name: resources_seekArchive
1018:1caf.note: Seeks the current archive file to an absolute position unless it is already there

1018:1cfc.name: resources_fileSlotFor
1018:1cfc.note: Maps a handle to its in-use file slot, or 0; caches the last lookup

1018:1da8.name: platform_messageBoxFromResource
1018:1da8.note: Loads a string resource, formats it with the varargs, beeps, and shows a MessageBox

1020:0000.name: audio_loadWaveResources
1020:0000.note: If Sounds is on, finds, loads, and locks the WAVESFX1..WAVESFX25 resources into a table

1020:0085.name: audio_closeMciDevice
1020:0085.note: If Sounds is on and an MCI device is open, sends MCI_CLOSE and clears the device id

1020:00ba.name: audio_playSound
1020:00ba.note: Plays WAVESFX sample 1..25 from memory with sndPlaySound when Sounds is on

1020:019c.name: platform_requestExit
1020:019c.note: Guarded exit: optional password dialog, then sends WM_CLOSE to the main window, or beeps on a wrong password

1020:0512.name: gfx_wipeEllipseOut
1020:0512.note: Transition: draws growing ellipses from the rect center, pumping input after each step

1020:05a0.name: gfx_wipeRectOut
1020:05a0.note: Transition: draws growing rectangles from the rect center, pumping input after each step

1020:0637.name: gfx_wipeRightToLeft
1020:0637.note: Transition: fills the rect in 1/100-width strips from right to left

1020:0688.name: gfx_wipeLeftToRight
1020:0688.note: Transition: fills the rect in 1/100-width strips from left to right

1020:06d2.name: gfx_wipeTopToBottom
1020:06d2.note: Transition: fills the rect in 1/200-height strips from top to bottom

1020:071c.name: gfx_wipeBottomToTop
1020:071c.note: Transition: fills the rect in 1/200-height strips from bottom to top

1020:081c.name: platform_debugLog
1020:081c.note: Printf-style debug log; empty in this build (only returns DS)

1028:0000.name: resources_storedRead
1028:0000.note: Method 0 read: copies input bytes to the output unchanged until input or request runs out; reached only through the method table's zero entry

1028:0024.name: resources_rleRead
1028:0024.note: Method 1 read: control byte bit 7 clear copies control&0x7f literal bytes, set repeats the next byte control&0x7f times

1028:0072.name: resources_storedWrite
1028:0072.note: Method 0 write: sends the bytes in the I/O ring unchanged to the output

1028:00b8.name: resources_readFileToFar
1028:00b8.note: Copies n bytes from the stream's file to a far address through a 50-byte bounce buffer; ignores the chunk length

1028:0125.name: resources_streamGetByte
1028:0125.note: Next input byte of the current stream, 0xFFFF once the chunk length is consumed

1028:0185.name: resources_streamReadBytes
1028:0185.note: Reads up to n input bytes into a near buffer, cut to the rest of the chunk; returns the count

1028:022e.name: resources_rleCopyLiteral
1028:022e.note: RLE literal of n bytes: straight to the destination, or to the I/O buffer and pause when the request is shorter

1028:02b4.name: resources_rleFillRun
1028:02b4.note: RLE run of n copies of a byte: straight to the destination, or to the I/O buffer and pause when the request is shorter

1028:0331.name: resources_streamPutByte
1028:0331.note: Hands one output byte to the caller; returns 0 and buffers it when the request is already full

1028:0384.name: resources_writeCompressedByte
1028:0384.note: Write side: appends one compressed byte to the stream's file or memory buffer

1028:03d0.name: resources_selectStream
1028:03d0.note: Validates a stream id and loads its record into the codec globals; 0 for a bad id

1028:048e.name: resources_freeStream
1028:048e.note: Frees a stream's I/O buffer, far codec state, and record, and clears its slot; returns 0xFFFF

1028:04f8.name: resources_allocStreamSlot
1028:04f8.note: Takes the first free of 100 stream slots and allocates a zeroed 0x21-byte record; -1 when full

1028:0547.name: resources_initStreamMethod
1028:0547.note: Checks the method (0..2), allocates the I/O buffer and far codec state from the method table, stores the method in the flags

1028:0615.name: resources_openStream
1028:0615.note: Opens a decompression stream on a file at a chunk body; read mode takes the method byte and u32 size from the file; returns stream id 0..99 or 0xFFFF

1028:076c.name: resources_openMemoryStream
1028:076c.note: Same as resources_openStream over a far memory buffer; never called

1028:0875.name: resources_closeStream
1028:0875.note: Closes a decompression stream and frees its buffers; write mode first flushes and patches the size

1028:0951.name: resources_drainBuffered
1028:0951.note: Copies bytes left in the I/O buffer to the destination, up to the bytes still requested

1028:09ca.name: resources_decodeInto
1028:09ca.note: Drains buffered bytes, runs the method's read function, drains again; returns bytes produced

1028:0a0d.name: resources_readStream
1028:0a0d.note: Reads up to count decompressed bytes into a far buffer; returns the count produced

1028:0a4b.name: resources_writeStream
1028:0a4b.note: Write side of resources_readStream: feeds bytes to the method's write function through the I/O ring; no callers

1028:0b0a.name: resources_streamSize
1028:0b0a.note: Uncompressed size from the stream header in DX:AX, 0xFFFFFFFF for a bad id

1028:0b36.name: resources_seekStream
1028:0b36.note: Seeks in decompressed bytes by decoding and discarding, rewinding first for backward seeks; no callers

1028:0c92.name: resources_rewindStream
1028:0c92.note: Restarts a read-mode stream at body + 5 and reruns the method's read init

1028:0d44.name: resources_lzwInit
1028:0d44.note: LZW read init: zeroes the state, width 9, free code 257, suffix i = i for i < 256

1028:0e04.name: resources_lzwRead
1028:0e04.note: LZW read: decodes codes through the prefix/suffix tables and a stack, handles clear (256), pauses when the request fills

1028:0fc1.name: resources_lzwReadCode
1028:0fc1.note: Next LZW code, LSB first, from groups of width bytes; grows the width or resets it after a clear; -1 at end of chunk

1028:10cb.name: resources_rleReadMemory
1028:10cb.note: RLE read for memory streams, working directly on the far source pointer

1028:11be.name: resources_lzwWriteInit
1028:11be.note: LZW write init: resets the encoder counters, width 9, free code 257, clears the hash table

1028:1233.name: resources_lzwWrite
1028:1233.note: LZW write: hashes prefix+byte pairs, emits codes, adds entries, checks the ratio once the table is full

1028:13cf.name: resources_lzwWriteCode
1028:13cf.note: Packs one LZW code into the output group, grows or resets the width; negative code flushes

1028:155d.name: resources_lzwRatioDivide
1028:155d.note: Far wrapper around 1000:03da (Borland signed 32-bit divide) for the LZW ratio check

1028:157c.name: resources_lzwCheckRatio
1028:157c.note: LZW write: emits a clear and resets the table when the compression ratio drops

1028:1654.name: resources_lzwClearHash
1028:1654.note: Fills n LZW hash table entries with -1

1028:1698.name: resources_rleWrite
1028:1698.note: Method 1 write: encodes the I/O ring into RLE runs and literals

1030:01c4.name: gfx_saveRectBits
1030:01c4.note: Copies a rect of the DC at 1068:1eb6 into a caller buffer with GetBitmapBits

1030:0250.name: gfx_restoreRectBits
1030:0250.note: Puts a caller buffer back with SetBitmapBits, blits it to the DC at 1068:1eb8, marks the rect dirty

1030:02ef.name: gfx_drawLine
1030:02ef.note: Draws a line in the foreground color and marks it dirty; dirty width is wrong when x2 < x1 or y2 < y1 (uses -a-b, not a-b)

1030:082c.name: platform_registerCursor
1030:082c.note: Adds a cursor of kind 0x1111, 0x2222, or 0x3333 to a growable global table; -1 and -2 mean the system arrow and wait cursors

1030:09d0.name: platform_removeCursor
1030:09d0.note: Removes a cursor from the table; 0x4444 resets the active cursor and frees the whole table

1030:0a8a.name: platform_setActiveCursor
1030:0a8a.note: Activates a table cursor; kind 0x3333 hides the system cursor, clips it to the window, and draws a software cursor

1030:1112.name: decoders_readBmpInfo
1030:1112.note: Seeks BMP:INF:, reads the image count, allocates 14-byte records, and reads every width then every height

1030:124a.name: decoders_loadBmp
1030:124a.note: Loads a BMP resource: info via BMP:INF:, pixel data from BMP:BIN:, optional BMP:VGA: or BMP:AMG: layer; returns a handle or 0

1030:16d8.name: decoders_loadScreen
1030:16d8.note: Loads a SCR resource: size from SCR:DIM: (default 320x200), SCR:BIN: decoded in strips, optional SCR:VGA: or SCR:AMG: layer

1030:199a.name: platform_farAlloc
1030:199a.note: Allocates a far block of a 32-bit size with flags; returns DX:AX

1038:063b.name: platform_nearFree
1038:063b.note: Frees a near block through LocalFree

1038:06a8.name: platform_nearCalloc
1038:06a8.note: Zeroed near allocation of count times size bytes

1038:1bd8.name: gfx_drawRect
1038:1bd8.note: Draws a rect: outline when fill is off or the rect is under 2 px, else filled (PATCOPY blit when both colors match); marks it dirty

1038:1d31.name: gfx_createColorBrush
1038:1d31.note: Solid brush for colors below 16 (or in 8-color mode), otherwise an 8x8 dither pattern brush built from the two color nibbles

1040:0286.name: gfx_blitPixelRows
1040:0286.note: Turns a buffer of pixel rows into a bitmap (via 1040:0000) and blits it to the offscreen DC, marking the rect dirty

1040:0688.name: gfx_drawCircle
1040:0688.note: Draws a circle of radius r at x,y with the current pen and brush colors and marks it dirty

1040:07e6.name: platform_addTimerCallback
1040:07e6.note: Registers a far callback in a 5-slot table with an interval in base ticks

1040:089a.name: platform_runTimerCallbacks
1040:089a.note: Fires every due timer callback and advances the base tick; after a pause only resets the slot times

1040:09eb.name: decoders_loadPalette
1040:09eb.note: Takes a free palette slot (1..9), seeks PAL:VGA:, reads 16 or 256 RGB triplets through a lookup table at 1068:25b0

1040:0d54.name: gfx_drawPixel
1040:0d54.note: Sets one pixel in the given color and marks it dirty

1040:0db0.name: decoders_loadBmpMatrix
1040:0db0.note: Reads a BMP:MTX: grid of tile indices, loads the BMP tiles, and composes them into one bitmap at 1068:45f8

1040:1113.name: gfx_blitBmpMatrix
1040:1113.note: Blits a rect of the composed BMP:MTX: bitmap to the offscreen DC and marks it dirty

1048:0079.name: ads_loadAds
1048:0079.note: Loads an ADS resource into one of 10 slots: ADS:RES: id/name pairs, then the ADS:SCR: script data; returns slot + 1 or 0

1060:0a23.name: platform_globalAllocLock
1060:0a23.note: GlobalAlloc with size in DX:AX and default flags plus GMEM_MOVEABLE, then GlobalLock

1060:0a53.name: platform_globalUnlockFree
1060:0a53.note: GlobalHandle on a far pointer, then GlobalUnlock and GlobalFree
